rungs.label: Better: permission not to know
rungs.prompt:
What was [competitor]'s revenue last year?
==If you're not sure, say "I don't know" instead of guessing.==

rungs.label: Best: one source, one fallback
rungs.prompt:
Using only the attached ==[annual report]==, what was [competitor]'s revenue last year?
Quote the line you used.
==If it isn't in the report, say "Not in the report".==
